Select the language you want to use in NeoGold.
NeoGold provides decision support for trained health workers. It suggests a next step to help you decide whether a newborn baby needs a blood test for jaundice.
NeoGold does not provide medical evaluation. It never claims that a baby is free of jaundice. Clinical signs and your professional judgment always take precedence.
Always confirm with a blood test
A smartphone camera estimate can never replace laboratory blood measurement. Always send the baby for a total serum bilirubin (TSB) test when in doubt.
Point the camera at the QR code on your verified NeoGold calibration card.
Take 3 photos of the card under room lighting on a flat surface. Photo %d of 3.
Intended use: Decision support for trained health workers. NeoGold is a screening tool, not a diagnostic device.
Limitations: Validated only for babies born at 35 weeks or later, up to 14 days of age, with no prior phototherapy.
This action cannot be undone. All screening sessions, local settings, encryption keys, and calibration records will be permanently erased.
A new version of NeoGold is available. You can continue using the app while it downloads.
A critical update is required before using NeoGold. Tap Update to download the latest version.

The baby shows clinical signs that need immediate attention at the hospital. A phone app was used to help decide whether a blood test is needed. Please take the baby to the hospital now so doctors can check the bilirubin levels.

The baby\'s estimated bilirubin level is close to the treatment threshold. A phone app was used to help decide whether a blood test is needed. A blood test is necessary today to measure the exact bilirubin level and protect the baby.

The baby\'s skin shows mild yellowing that needs follow-up. A phone app was used to help decide whether a blood test is needed. Please bring the baby back for another check at the scheduled time, or sooner if feeding changes, sleepiness, or other danger signs appear.

The baby does not require immediate referral from this screen. A phone app was used to help decide whether a blood test is needed. Continue routine feeding and newborn care, and bring the baby back immediately if you notice danger signs such as poor feeding, unusual sleepiness, high-pitched cry, or arching.
Card not found. Place the card on the baby\'s chest and ensure all 4 corners are visible.
Card is tilted. Hold the phone directly above the card.
Uneven light across the card. Turn away from bright lights or shadows.
Photo is blurry. Hold the phone steady.
Too much glare. Move away from the window.
Not enough light. Move to a better-lit area.
Too much light. Move away from direct bright light.
